done_when: After one browser test fails, the remaining browser tests still run under forge test, and the preload helper is found from where Forge is installed

known.title: Follow-up: Cover real Playwright replacement workers on Windows

findings.body:
Gain 2, Work 3, Harm 2
The proof list explicitly identifies real Playwright execution on Windows as missing. This regression starts two plain Node processes; it verifies preload lifetime but never exercises Playwright replacing a failed browser worker. Add the declared follow-up through `forge test --change`, checking that subsequent browser cases execute after the installed helper disappears.
Adds work: real Playwright regression on Windows; F 1 x H 2 = 2; 2 x C = 4
findings.title: Follow-up: Cover real Playwright replacement workers on Windows

why: Playwright's replacement workers in a client app cannot load Forge's preload helper, so browser tests after the first failure do not run (issue 1379)
